item.title: Adjustable Dumbbells Buying Checklist: 8 Things to Check First
item.description: An adjustable dumbbells buying checklist with eight things to check before you order: weight range, small jumps, how fast the weight changes, grip, storage, noise and the return policy. Plain advice from a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.
